liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd76-08-04.jones.vernon.12078.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 212 min; rated 3/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is average, with a tripper freaking out during the Help intro [23]
- **gd76-08-04.sbd.cotsman.12830.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 198 min; rated 4.16/5 by 25 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording features erratic quality, heavy bass, and multiple audience patches [16]
- **gd1976-08-04.sbd.miller-tobin.35171.flac**: soundboard; 22 songs; 214 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [4]
- **gd1976-08-04.127240.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 206 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1976-08-04.sbd.backus.6677.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 191 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Unwanted noise remains in the recording, as noted in the Taping Compendium [12]

## Around the show

- Garcia called Roosevelt and Stanley venues favorites; band added four Jersey dates after 1972 [15]
- A trained chimpanzee performed on stage between sets while its handler pleaded with the crowd [16]
- A couple in a sleeping bag at the infield back was getting intimate during the show [17]
- Fans sat in hot sun all day, leaving the crowd low-key when the band started [18]
- Crowd wore fluorescent green shirts and glow sticks while watching from the decaying stadium field [20]
- Mr. Jiggs fell on roller skates while being pelted with light sticks and change [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-08-04.jones.vernon.12078.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Scott Jones; source: Audience Recording: Shure [1]. Also: Scott Jones recorded source one using Shure mics and a Sony TC-158 [1]
- **gd76-08-04.sbd.cotsman.12830.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1976-08-04.sbd.miller-tobin.35171.flac**: taped by See info file; transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD>Cm>Reel>Lucid AD2496>CD>EAC>SHN [4]. Also: Patrick Clifford provided audio to match the 2005 BHP black and white video [4]
- **gd1976-08-04.127240.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (55%-SBD/45%-AUD) from SBD1 (shnid=35171), SBD2 (no shn ID) and AUD1 (shnid=12078) [5]. Also: Set one audio was patched using video soundtrack for timing and blending purposes [5]
- **gd1976-08-04.sbd.backus.6677.shnf**: transferred by David Backus; source: MSR->C->DAT->CDR->EAC->SHN V.3 [12]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Grateful Dead @ Roosevelt Stadium NJ August 1976](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/grateful-dead-roosevelt-stadium-nj-august-1976) [27]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Roosevelt Stadium - August 4, 1976](https://www.dead.net/show/august-4-1976) [28]
- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [Roosevelt Stadium, Danforth Ave and NJ Rte 1 NJ440, Jersey City, NJ 1972-76 (Jersey City Story)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2013/12/roosevelt-stadium-danforth-ave-and-nj.html) [29]
